svg.title: Reliability before and after recalibration
svg.desc: Leave-one-task-out P(hacked) vs observed hack frequency · ten equal-width bins · label: labeller OR judge
svg.text: Leave-one-task-out P(hacked) vs observed hack frequency · ten equal-width bins · label: labeller OR judge
Dashed diagonal: perfect calibration. Larger dots: more trajectories. Bins with < 3 trajectories omitted (ECE still counts them).
